_: Seam ledger for the design-engineering launch film. One row per scene change, typed cut / match-cut / morph (references/launch-video/launch-video-seams.md). A cut row carries signed vectors (x -1 leftward, y -1 upward, z +1 push); a morph row names its carrier. Values are HyperFrames' seam-stamp values, written by hand (references/launch-video/hyperframes-reconciliation.md). Every exit is still moving on the cut frame, or the cut sits inside a full-frame fill.

seams.technique: poster frame: two frames of the endcard lockup, then the film
seams.note: the one deliberate static cut; it sets the thumbnail (Skale opens 9 of 29 films this way)

seams.technique: fill the frame: the click is the seam
constant ground: ink on both sides

entry.note: the incoming frame acts within 0.27 s (the caret's first blink): stillness before the name, not a dead cut

seams.technique: zoom into a glyph: the caret block's paper becomes the ground
cut the curve, in the current
fill the frame: the parked playhead widens into the next ground
hard cut on a palette flip (blue → ink), mid-motion, upward
seams.note: upward is a reserved vector: the conclusion rises

seams.technique: collapse to a carrier dot; paper grows out of it
